name: Yamakai Tsurubi
source: A visitor who is currently staying at Tokage's place along with Kukuri. She has been Kukuri's caretaker since her birth. Having a strong desire for power, she establishes a principle of going after any forms of new training methods or nutritional supplements and so on. Although she is not a User herself, her physical combat strength can still be comparable to any other Users around.
